baseline.result: Two finite-projection panics; a huge diameter omitted from spacing candidates; a later IPC record lost after a preceding unprojectable point shifted indices; skipped unresolved center/diameter/edge-membership decisions; and definite findings from unresolved spacing orders. Exact boundary/nearby-distinct thresholds and IPC records without diameter passed as controls.

contract: The drill spacing grid stores certified outward bounds of native center +/- radius. Unknown, unrepresentable, invalid and oversized envelopes remain fallback candidates. The shared grid bounds each enclosure scheduling range to 256 cells without dropping the corresponding source index.

Spacing queries use a certified native radius upper bound and signed native circular edge gaps through Scalar::hypot2. Negative spacing retains overlap semantics; required negative/unknown drill radii, unavailable metrics and unresolved comparisons fail typed.

Native point queries preserve all source indices for cross-source drill/IPC matching, including unprojectable records. Missing IPC diameters skip irrelevant matching work. Checked squared-distance and diameter comparisons replace optional/boolean flattening. Required report markers use finite checked projection.
All five migrated checks run under the shared STRICT/budget guard. Uncertainty becomes a blocking readiness receipt and cannot escape an exhausted scope as an ordinary definite result.
Hardware-hole threshold clamping and diameter eligibility use checked comparisons. Its distribution consumer now retains selection errors; its remaining hull/spread/report path is still open.

Castellation selection prepares the authoritative native outline once and checks whether a drill center lies within radius + edge_distance of its boundary. This applies the circular drill-proxy reach criterion consistently to rectangular and curved outlines, without the old report-rectangle selector or circle-boundary reconstruction.
Implementation version advances from 9 to 10; schema remains 1. All six Easyduino snapshots change only their 160 implementation-version fields per board.

consumer_validation.scope: Six Easyduino snapshots, one impedance unit and two smoke tests selected by hyperdrc, plus five curved-outline tests. This is not the complete HyperCircuit suite.

cost.limitations: Five sequential fresh processes pinned to CPU 0 after all builds and tests exit. The previous 48 witnesses and iteration counts are unchanged. Twelve new rows time complete native drill spacing, cross-source table/IPC checks, hardware spacing and castellation selection/spacing, including index construction, predicates and report allocation. Native constant inputs and first/last full finding fingerprints are outside timers. Curved outlines use their original 17/128 report views; internal geometry evidence may be warm. The 2,002-drill sparse field is retained. All 60 output rows must match across trials. This is capability cost, not a matched speedup, allocation-count or library-size comparison. Whole-process RSS includes the prior million-sample fixture. The full two-board/Gerber workload and 120-second gate are unchanged.
